AC AMENDMENT (plan-review F2 critical): Add test for single-oversized-file case.
- [ ] Test case: a diff with ONE file > reviewer context ceiling (e.g., 8000+ lines, no other files)
- Strategy F must EITHER: (a) pass-through as a single-cluster dispatch with an explicit 'oversized_single_file: true' flag (caller handles truncation/aggregation), OR (b) sub-chunk by hunks within the single file
- Decision must be recorded in code comment + CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md note
  Verify: grep -qE 'oversized.single.file|intra.file|single_file_oversized' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_region_split.py
